scripts.dev:web: concurrently --names "web,workers" --prefix-colors "blue,red" "cd apps/web && bun run dev" "cd apps/workers && bun run dev"
scripts.dev:linux: concurrently --names "native,workers" --prefix-colors "yellow,red" "cd apps/native && bun run dev:linux" "cd apps/workers && bun run dev"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --names "web,workers,presence" --prefix-colors "blue,red,green" "cd apps/web && bun run dev" "cd apps/workers && bun run dev" "cd apps/presence && mix phx.server"
scripts.check:rust: cd apps/native/src-tauri && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.check-types: turbo run check-types && bunx tsc --noEmit -p scripts/versioning/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.db:push: cd packages/db && bun prisma db push
scripts.test:unit:packages: bash -c 'EXIT=0; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/ai/src/*.test.ts || EXIT=$?; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/db/src/*.test.ts || EXIT=$?; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/logger/src/*.test.ts || EXIT=$?; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/native-bridge/src/*.test.ts || EXIT=$?; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/yjs-shared/src/*.test.ts || EXIT=$?; exit $EXIT'
scripts.test:coverage:packages: bash -c 'EXIT=0; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/ai/src/*.test.ts --coverage || EXIT=$?; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/db/src/*.test.ts --coverage || EXIT=$?; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/logger/src/config.test.ts ./packages/logger/src/logger.test.ts ./packages/logger/src/tracer.test.ts ./packages/logger/src/metrics.test.ts --coverage || EXIT=$?; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/native-bridge/src/*.test.ts --coverage || EXIT=$?; bun test --preload ./tests/config/bun.setup.ts ./packages/yjs-shared/src/*.test.ts --coverage || EXIT=$?; exit $EXIT'
scripts.test:coverage: bun run test:coverage:web && bun run test:coverage:workers && bun run test:coverage:packages
